name: OpenCode
description: Open-source terminal agent. Spells models as `provider/model`; its JSON (or JSONC) config and provider credentials sit under the XDG config and data dirs.

files.purpose: Main config: `model`, `small_model`, and provider entries. May also be named opencode.jsonc.

fields.description: A provider entry: npm, options (baseURL, apiKey), models.
